title: Agent to agent brief
description: What one agent hands another to start work. Extends the compaction-guard a2a envelope (schema, version, id, at, kind, status_code, from, to, subject, facts, actions, reply, refs) with acceptance_criteria and done_token. Owner rule 2026-10-16: 'agent to agent prose sucks, schemas with defined AC always'. Prose is for the owner only. Upgrade an older brief with bin/brief.sh migrate, never by hand.

version.description: Version of the producer that wrote the brief.

status_code.description: A2A-001 brief issued, A2A-004 SOP breach. See README section Status codes.

work_order.description: Ready work order a build seat starts from; brief-check BUILD=1 refuses a brief without one.

facts.description: Inventory, never narrative: owner words, rules, worktree, branch, reuse list.

actions.description: What the receiver does, in order.

proof.description: What ticks it: the command to run, the file to show, the url to cite, the screenshot to attach.

done_token.description: The exact final line the receiver ends with.

result_file.description: Where the receiver writes its result JSON, valid against zenith.a2a.result.v1.
